title: Jingle. Bloo.
html_source: “Jingle” refers to Boylan. This line is a juxtaposition of Boylan and Bloom. The jingle is of Boylan’s carriage as he leaves the Ormond Hotel for 7 Eccles Street.

anchor.prefix:
jaunted jingling. 

 Coin rang. Clock clacked. 

 Avowal. Sonnez. I could. Rebound of garter. Not leave thee. Smack. La cloche! Thigh smack. Avowal. Warm. Sweetheart, goodbye!
anchor.suffix:
